_help.tribunals: Court and tribunal names exactly as they appear on document headings (any case).
_help.case_ref_patterns: Python regexes for case numbers; first capture group is the number. Test on real examples.
_help.judgment_source_markers: Lower-case words printed on judgments downloaded from free sources (e.g. 'bailii').
_help.judgment_patterns: Python regexes, matched case-insensitively, that identify a judgment (e.g. a neutral citation form).
_help.own_authors: Filled by setup: the user's names as Word author.
